==Standard dialogue==
* {{Tcond|First time:}}
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Greetings, adventurer! I see that you're new here. My name is Phileas, but people often call me the Lumbridge Guide. I'm always happy to give out tips to budding adventurers. Is there anything I can help you with?
** {{tact|continue}}
* {{Tcond|Subsequent times:}}
** {{tcond|If the player has experience to claim:}}
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' It seems you're missing out on some valuable experience. Would you like it?
*** {{tbox|You are owed the following: [list of experience the player can claim]}}
*** {{tselect|Claim your owed XP?}}
*** {{topt|Yes please.}}
**** '''Player:''' Yes please.
**** {{tact|receives=owed experience}}
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' There you go.
**** {{tact|continue}}<!--skips introduction and goes straight to "select an option"-->
*** {{topt|No thanks.}}
**** '''Player:''' No thanks.
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Fair enough.
**** {{tact|continue}}<!--skips introduction and goes straight to "select an option"-->
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Hello there, adventurer! Is there anything I can help you with?
* {{tselect|Select an option}}
* {{topt|What kind of goals should I be aiming for?}}
** '''Player:''' What kind of goals should I be aiming for?
** {{tcond|Unknown condition:}}
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Well, in truth, I'm not really sure. I think you've managed to reach a point where my advice isn't really going to be useful any more. I'd say it's all on you now.
*** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|I'm looking for a quest to go on.}}
** {{tmissing|Seems probably mostly the same as original dialogue, but he now recommends the mudfoot quest}}
* {{topt|What's the best way to get better at combat?}}
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' For that, I'd suggest you talk to Captain Harlan. He's the local expert on combat. You'll find him just north of the castle, outside the General Store.
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|How should I go about improving my skills?}}
** '''Player:''' How should I go about improving my skills?
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Well, in general you'll find that practice makes perfect. The best way to improve a skill is to quite simply keep working at it.
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' As for specifics, I can't cover every skill, but I can give you a few tips for some of the more common ones.
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' For mining, you'll want to head to a mine like the one south of Lumbridge and mine some ores with a pickaxe. You can either sell the ores for money, or smelt them into bars.
** {{tbox|pic=5082 detail.png|Ores can be mined at mining sites, provided you have a pickaxe. To find a mining site, just look for the relevant icon on your map.}}
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' On that topic, you can improve your smithing by smelting ores into bars and then by smithing those bars into weapons and armour. Might be you'll want those weapons and armour yourself, or you could sell them.
** {{tbox|pic=5084 detail.png|Ores can be smelted into bars at a furnace. To find a furnace, just look for the relevant icon on your map.}}
** {{tbox|pic=Smithing icon (interface) detail.png|Metal bars can be smithed into weapons and armour at an anvil, provided you have a hammer. To find an anvil, just look for the relevant icon on your map.}}
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' For fishing, you can catch all kinds of fish at various fishing spots. You could just sell what you catch, but I'd suggest cooking them into food, which will also improve your cooking abilities.
** {{tbox|pic=5088 detail.png|Fish can be caught at various fishing spots, provided you have the suitable equipment. To find a fishing spot, just look for the relevant icon on your map.}}
** {{tbox|pic=5090 detail.png|Food can be cooked on either a fire or a range, but you'll be less likely to burn things on a range. To find a range, just look for the relevant icon on your map.}}
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Woodcutting is much like mining. Just grab an axe, head to some trees, and chop away. You can then sell the logs, or burn them.
** {{tbox|pic=9713 detail.png|You can chop trees all over the world, provided you have an axe. You'll rarely have trouble finding a common tree, but to find rarer trees, look for the relevant icon on your map.}}
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' I could keep going, but I think you get the idea. In general, most skills are trained in specific locations, or using specific items. Gather what you need, head to where you need to go, then get to work.
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' A lot of the time, you'll find yourself gathering or producing something. You can then sell those things, or keep them and use them yourself.
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' If you need any more tips, you'll find plenty of people around here willing to lend you a hand. No doubt you'll end up finding a few other useful resources out there as well.
** {{tbox|pic=Stats icon.png|To learn more about a specific skill, see the relevant guide in the Skills panel.}}
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|More options...}}
** {{tselect|Select an option}}
** {{topt|What's a good way to make money?}}
*** '''Player:''' What's a good way to make money?
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Normally the most reliable way is to sell things. As for where you get said things, you could collect items from dead foes. Goblins for example sometimes have a few things of note on them.
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Alternatively, you could make or gather items to then sell on. For example, logs from woodcutting, ores from mining, weapons and armour from smithing... the list goes on.
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' As for where to sell things, that depends. The quick and easy way is to sell to a General Store. They're easy to find and will accept almost anything, but they're unlikely to give you the best prices.
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' A better but slower option is to sell to specialist stores. For example, a blacksmith will most likely offer you a better price for weapons and armour, but won't accept any of your other goods.
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' All that said, the best option is often the Grand Exchange. You can buy or sell pretty much anything there, and in many cases it's where you'll get the best prices.
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' However, it does require a trek up to Varrock, and the road isn't always the safest, so I'd only recommend making the journey once you're feeling comfortable.
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Whatever you decide, don't forget that you don't need to go carrying everything on you. You can store all of your items, including any goods you've gathered or made, in your bank.
*** {{tact|other}}
** {{topt|Where can I find a bank?}}
*** '''Player:''' Where can I find a bank?
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Most towns have one. The one here in Lumbridge is on the roof of the castle.
*** {{tbox|pic=5080 detail.png|You can store your items in a bank. To find one, look for the relevant icon on your map.}}
*** {{tact|other}}

*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Not to worry. I found it again.
*** {{tcond|If the player has no inventory space:}}
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' However, you'll need to make space for it before I can give it to you.
**** {{tact|end}}
*** {{tbox|pic=Amulet of the Eye detail.png|Phileas hands you the Amulet of the Eye.}}
*** '''Player:''' Thanks. I'll try not to lose it this time.
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Any time.
*** {{tact|previous}}
** {{topt|I'd better be off.}}
*** '''Player:''' I'd better be off.
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Until next time, adventurer,{{sic}}
*** {{tact|end}}

==Giving him the tarnished locket==
===First time===
* '''Player:''' Does the name 'Philly' mean anything to you by chance?
* {{tbox|pic=Tarnished locket detail.png|You present the locket to the Lumbridge Guide.}}
* '''Lumbridge Guide:''' That locket! Where did you get it?
* '''Player:''' I found it in a magical rift. Does it belong to you?
* '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Not exactly... It's a long and sad story.
* {{topt|It's okay, I have time to listen.}}
** '''Player:''' It's okay, I have time to listen.
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Well, if you're sure then.
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' It all started in my youth when I was part of the Order of Wizards. I frequently spent time travelling across Gielinor, which kept me away from my beloved who worked here in Lumbridge.
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Due to being apart, I would often send her gifts. This locket was one of them.
** '''Player:''' I see... I'm not sure I like where this story is going. How come I found the locket in a magic rift then?
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' As I said, my research often kept me away from home. During one of my trips away, our house was robbed. My dear Thenia tried to stop them, but they took her life in return. The locket was taken in the robbery.
** '''Player:''' Oh my... I'm so sorry for your loss.
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' I appreciate your kind words, but this was a long time ago. The pain of losing a loved one never fades, but in time you come to live with it.
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Anyway, after that I stepped down from the Order of Wizards. I now spend my days offering guidance to those who come through Lumbridge.
** '''Player:''' I'm still curious to know how it ended up in some rift. Do you have any theories?
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Well... where was this rift?
** '''Player:''' In an ancient temple. Most things in the rift came from the Abyss.
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' The Abyss? I wasn't aware anyone had ever been to the Abyss.
** '''Player:''' They hadn't until recently, but the Z.M.I. found a way there.
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' The Z.M.I.? But could that mean...
** '''Player:''' What?
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Oh, nothing to worry about. Just me being a silly old man. Tell me more about this temple.
** '''Player:''' It's called the Temple of the Eye. It was built by Saradominist wizards long ago to house a powerful artefact.
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' The Eye?
** '''Player:''' You've heard of it?
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Only stories, of which there are very few. Still, I always believed them to be real. After all, why else would an eye be the symbol of the Order of Wizards?
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Ah, but that reminds me, I was not the first in my family to join the order. This amulet was passed down from generation to generation.
** {{tbox|pic=Amulet of the Eye detail.png|Phileas shows you an amulet.}}
** '''Player:''' That looks just like the amulet that led us to the temple!
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' As soon as you mentioned it, I wondered if there might be a connection.
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' The origin of this amulet was something I spent much time puzzling over when I was younger. I'm glad you have answered the question I couldn't.
** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' I'd be happy to give you this amulet in return for that locket. I have no use for it, but that locket is something which holds a lot of sentimental value to me.
** {{topt|Of course you can have the locket.}}
*** '''Player:''' Of course you can have the locket.
*** {{tbox|pic=Tarnished locket detail.png|pic2=Amulet of the Eye detail.png|You exchange the locket for the amulet.}}
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Thank you for returning this to me. I wish you the best of luck on the rest of your adventures.
*** '''Player:''' Thanks, Phileas. I wish you luck also.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|I'd rather keep the locket for myself.}}
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Oh, I see. I guess I can't really force you to hand it over. The offer still stands if you ever change your mind.
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{topt|Never mind then. I have to go.}}
** '''Player:''' Never mind then. I have to go.
** {{tact|end}}

===After not giving him the amulet===
* '''Lumbridge Guide:''' You're back. Would you consider giving me that locket? It holds a lot of sentimental value to me. I'll give you that amulet in return.
* {{topt|Of course you can have the locket.}}
** {{tact|above}}
* {{topt|I'd rather keep the locket for myself.}}
** {{tact|above}}

**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' There's lots of beasts to fight in the woods around here, especially to the west. There are certainly some goblins and spiders that are pests and could do with being cleared out. There's also a chicken farm or two up the
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' road for some fairly easy pickings. Non-player characters usually appear as yellow dots on your minimap, although there are some that you won't be able to fight, such as myself. A monster's combat level is
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' shown next to their 'Attack' option. If that level is coloured green it means the monster is weaker than you. If it is red, it means that the monster is tougher than you.
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Remember, you will do better if you have better armour and weapons and it's always worth carrying a bit of food to heal yourself.
**** {{topt|Where can I get food to heal myself?}}
***** '''Player:''' Where can I get food to heal myself?
***** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' There are many different foods in the game such as cabbage, fish, meat and many more. Which do you wish to hear about?

****** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' You could also farm your own cabbages; there's a Farming patch just south of Falador.

** {{topt|I'd like to know more about security.}}
*** '''Player:''' I'd like to know more about security.
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' First I must warn you to take every precaution to keep your RuneScape password and PIN secure. The most important thing to remember is to never give your password to, or share your account with, anyone.
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' I can also tell you about password security, avoiding item scamming and in-game moderation. I can also tell you about a place called the Stronghold of Security, where you can learn more about account security and
*** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' have a bit of an adventure at the same time.
*** {{topt|I'd like to know about password security.}}
**** '''Player:''' I'd like to know about password security.
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Well, the first thing to remember with password security, which I can't stress enough, is to never tell your password, bank PIN or authenticator details to anyone, not even if they claim to be Jagex staff. Real
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Jagex staff will NEVER ask for your password. Sharing your account is a very bad idea, even if you think that you know and trust the person you are sharing with. Players have lost items and even their
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' account this way. Sharing accounts is also against the rules.
**** '''Player:''' Is there anything else to be aware of?
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Yes, also be careful where you enter your password. Be aware that fake Old School RuneScape websites exist. These are sites that claim to give things such as item/stat upgrades, free items, beta testing and
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' moderator applications. Jagex do not offer any of these services.
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Also be aware of trojans and keyloggers. These nasty programs can send everything you type into your device back to the computers of malicious people, so you can lose more than just your Old School RuneScape
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' password in this way. To avoid getting these on your device, be very wary of what you download, especially when it comes to downloading third party software. Also be very wary of email attachments and instant
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' messenger file transfers, which can contain such things.
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Finally, remember the game doesn't censor your password or bank PIN when you type them; anyone who tells you otherwise is probably trying to steal your character or items.
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Is there anything else you need help with?
**** {{topt|Tell me more about security.}}

*** {{topt|I'd like to know more about avoiding item scamming.}}
**** '''Player:''' I'd like to know more about avoiding item scamming.
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' There are many nice and helpful players in Old School RuneScape; unfortunately, as in real life, there are some who aren't so honest. Some people may try to trick you out of your items. Try not to fall for this as
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Jagex policy is to never return lost items to players that have been scammed. Doing so just encourages users to claim they lost items they never had to gain an unfair advantage. However, people carrying out such
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' scams will get banned as it is against the rules.
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' When trading, you have a second trade confirmation screen. Always double check that you are getting the items you expect on this page as some people may try and change what they are trading at the last minute on
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' the first trade screen. Remember when you have clicked accept on the second trade screen, the trade is not reversible.
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Try and find out from someone else what an item is before spending a lot of money on it. Not all merchants are honest about the rarity or the uses of their wares. For example, some people try to pass off spinach rolls as
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' rare when in fact they're as common as cabbages!
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Be wary of people offering to improve your items. For example, some people will claim they can add a trim to your armour or upgrade your sword to a more powerful one. This is not possible and they are trying
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' to steal your hard-earned equipment.
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Is there anything else you need help with?

*** {{topt|I'd like to know more about in-game moderation.}}
**** '''Player:''' I'd like to know more about in-game moderation.
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' You will, from time to time, see moderator characters in game. Remember: a real staff member will never ask for your password or any other personal information. There are two types of moderator. You may see Jagex
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' staff characters in game - these can be identified by a gold crown next to their name and are the people who work in the Jagex offices. They might be from Customer Support, or they might be a tester or a
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' programmer. You may also see player moderators - these can be identified by a silver crown next to their name. Player moderators are trusted players of Old School RuneScape that help keep in-game behaviour in
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' line with the Old School RuneScape rules.
**** '''Player:''' How do I become a player moderator?
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' The only way to become a player moderator is to know and play by the rules laid down by Jagex. Report those who break the rules, help players who need it and one day you might find an invite to become a moderator in
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' your Old School RuneScape inbox. Note that Jagex will never contact you in game or by email to become a player moderator.
**** '''Lumbridge Guide:''' Is there anything else you need help with?
